name: buildy-website-app-builder
description: Build, host and launch complete websites, web apps, online stores, landing pages and sales funnels with Buildy.

interface.longDescription:
Buildy Website & App Builder helps you create & launch complete websites, web apps, online stores, landing pages and sales funnels from simple natural-language instructions.

Tell Buildy what you want to make and it turns your idea into a working project. You can create a business website, generate an ecommerce store, build a custom web app, or make a complete sales funnel without having to write the underlying code yourself.

Buildy goes beyond a simple generator of a design, mockup or code sample. It can create the pages, content, forms, database, user accounts, workflows, business logic, payments and supported integrations needed for a functional finished product. It can build full-stack applications, SaaS products, customer portals, dashboards, membership experiences, ecommerce storefronts, lead-generation pages and multi-step sales funnels.

For someone looking for an AI website creator or website maker, Buildy can take a business idea and turn it into a complete multi-page site. As an app creator, it can generate interactive web applications with databases, logins and custom workflows. It can also act as an online store maker for ecommerce projects and a funnel generator for landing pages, sales pages, lead capture and multi-step conversion flows.

Every project can be previewed and refined through conversation. Ask Buildy to change the design, add a page, modify functionality, connect data, add features or update existing content, and Buildy can continue working on the same project.

Buildy not only will make your project, it also handles the technology required to get the finished project online. Hosting, SSL and publishing are built in, and projects can use a live web address or connect to a custom domain. This means a user can go from an idea to a working, hosted and launched website, app, store or sales funnel in minutes.

Buildy is designed for entrepreneurs, small businesses, creators, professionals and agencies that want to create and launch a real working web product without having to manage the code, database, servers, hosting or deployment themselves.

defaultPrompt: Build a complete website or web app from my idea and get it ready to launch.
Create an online store where customers can browse and buy my products.
Build a sales funnel with a landing page, sales page and thank-you page.

positive.description: 1. Create a business website. Start a new ChatGPT conversation with Buildy connected to the reviewer account. Run positive cases 1-5 in order in this same conversation, using the project created in this case. Recording: 1:02-1:47.
positive.prompt: Build a professional website for my residential plumbing company, Summit Flow Plumbing, with services, testimonials and a contact form. Name the project Summit Flow Plumbing.
positive.expected_behavior: Buildy creates a new Summit Flow Plumbing website in the reviewer account. The Buildy card shows progress, then a ready preview with services, testimonials and a contact form. Allow several minutes for generation; the card refreshes while Buildy works. The site is not published by this request. Use this new project for the remaining positive cases.

positive.description: 2. Add content to the website from case 1. Continue in the same conversation after the initial build finishes. Recording: 2:02-2:42.
positive.prompt: In my Summit Flow Plumbing project, add a pricing section with three packages: Drain Cleaning, Water Heater Install and Full Repipe, each with a short description and a starting price.
positive.expected_behavior: Buildy updates the same project with a pricing section for Drain Cleaning, Water Heater Install and Full Repipe. Each package has a short description and a starting price. After the update finishes, the card shows the updated preview. No new project is created and the site is not published.

positive.description: 3. Change the headline and contact form on the same website. Continue after case 2 finishes. Recording: 3:00-4:27; the published form is also shown around 5:06.
positive.prompt: In my Summit Flow Plumbing project, change the main headline to 'Plumbing Done Right, the First Time' and add a service address field to the contact form.
positive.expected_behavior: Buildy changes the main headline to 'Plumbing Done Right, the First Time' and adds a Service Address field to the contact form in the same project. The updated headline and field are visible after the build finishes. Existing sections, including pricing, remain. This request does not publish the site.

positive.description: 4. Publish the website. Continue in the same conversation after the changes from case 3 finish. Recording: 4:45-5:08.
positive.prompt: Publish my Summit Flow Plumbing site.
positive.tools_triggered: publish_project, get_project_status (if publication is still in progress)
positive.expected_behavior: Buildy publishes the current version of the same project after this explicit request. ChatGPT waits for confirmed success before saying the site is live. The card shows the publication result and an Open published site button, and ChatGPT returns the live link. Opening that link displays the published site with the updated headline, pricing section and Service Address field.

positive.description: 5. Summarize the project and return its live link. Continue after publication in case 4. Recording: 5:24-5:36.
positive.prompt: Summarize what Buildy has built so far in my Summit Flow Plumbing project and give me the live link.
positive.tools_triggered: get_project or get_project_status; get_conversation_history if earlier Buildy messages are needed
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT returns a summary of the same project, including its services, pricing section, updated headline and Service Address field, along with its confirmed published link. It uses the current project result and relevant conversation context. This is a read-only request: it does not create a project, send an edit request or publish again.

negative.description: Advice question, no project should be created. The user asks for a comparison, not for Buildy to build anything, so ChatGPT should answer in chat and not call create_website, create_web_app or any other Buildy tool that changes data.
negative.prompt: Should I build a normal website or a web app for a customer portal? Explain the pros and cons.

negative.description: Planning question, no project should be created. The user wants a list of pages, not a site, so ChatGPT should answer in chat without creating a Buildy project.
negative.prompt: What pages should a good website for a plumbing company have?

negative.description: General domain question, no project or domain should change. The user asks how DNS works, so ChatGPT should explain it in chat and not change any Buildy project, domain or DNS setting.
negative.prompt: Explain how DNS records work when connecting a custom domain.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Create websites, online stores, web apps and sales funnels from ChatGPT, update existing Buildy projects, and publish them. A Buildy card shows build progress and a live preview.
